caption: The drawing features a single, transparent glass pitcher depicted in a light blue-green hue. The pitcher has a bulbous body with a narrow neck that flares outward at the mouth, and a pour spout at the top. There are four decorative, rounded protrusions at the sides of the body. The handle is attached from the upper neck to the widest part of the body and curves outward before reconnecting near the base. The base of the pitcher is slightly raised and circular. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige background. The artist's signature "G. Capelli" is written in small, neat text in the bottom left corner.
title: Creamer
